items.title: Add smoke repro of review-window execution poisoning and the new pass/fail boundary
items.context: Replay the B-956f shape in flow-stability-smoke: pre-TEST reviewer executed terminal plus one post-TEST closeout executed terminal in the same identity group must PASS convergence after the fix but fails before it; two post-TEST executed terminals in the same group must still FAIL; a reused terminal with commandExecutions greater than zero must still FAIL in any phase. Real-world telemetry evidence: .lattice/story/actives/B-956f/process-events.jsonl round 18:10:20 window events at 18:25:19 executed 34090591, 18:36:10 executed 15aa0ab1, 19:02:20 executed 34090591 TEST phase.
items.userSees: Running the new flow-stability-smoke convergence case prints a passing assertion for the B-956f-shaped window (pre-TEST reviewer executed + one post-TEST closeout executed in the same group does NOT throw) and failing assertions still throw done_prepare convergence invariant failed for two post-TEST duplicates and for contradictory reused terminals

happy.desc: B-956f-shaped window (two pre-TEST executed groups + one post-TEST executed duplicate of a pre-TEST group + reused exec=0) passes assertDonePreparePassConvergence with blocking counter 0 and observable counter 1

edge.desc: Window with two post-TEST executed terminals in the same identity group yields blocking counter 1 and assert throws
Group whose only executed terminal is post-TEST (no pre-TEST baseline) yields blocking 0 and observable 0

adversarial.desc: Reused terminal reporting commandExecutions greater than zero keeps failing convergence regardless of phase (pre-TEST or post-TEST)

items.title: Split convergence counting into blocking post-TEST duplicates and observable review-window telemetry
items.context: In deriveDonePreparePassConvergence: keep field unchangedSuiteExecutions as the blocking counter but compute it as per-group max(0, postTestExecutedCount - 1) using facts.testEntryAt as the boundary, plus contradictory reused terminals with commandExecutions greater than zero in any phase; add a new observable field reviewWindowSuiteExecutions = per-group max(0, totalExecutedCount - 1) counted across the whole window so redundancy stays visible without blocking. Update DonePrepareConvergence type at done-prepare.ts:205, the transcript regex parser at :1077-:1097, the render line at :1666, and assertDonePreparePassConvergence which must keep asserting only on the blocking fields.

items.title: Update downstream smoke assertions and process-fact documentation to the split semantics
